newsitem.title: GREECE: DRACHMA UP VS ECU, OTHER MKTS CALM, AWAIT FIX.
newsitem.headline: DRACHMA UP VS ECU, OTHER MKTS CALM, AWAIT FIX.

text.p: The drachma gained some ground against the ecu after mid-session, trading around 309.73/78 compared with an opening 310 on ecu selling from local and London-based banks, dealers said.
Bonds were holding at lower levels in quiet dealings. Depos were drifting lower but forex forwards had a firmer tone after falling this morning.

"We are awaiting the fixing but it looks as if we are going back to normal market conditions, but interest rates are still high," said a dealer. --Dimitris Kontogiannis, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
